indicators.title: Ratio of Total Assets Held by Top 5 Holding Companies to Total Bank Holding Company Assets
indicators.source: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC) / Chicago Fed, Y-9C bulk data
indicators.definition: 100 x (sum of total assets BHCK2170 for the 5 largest BHCs) / (sum across all Y-9C filers), percent.
indicators.note: Chicago Fed bulk files mix filer universes across quarters (Q1/Q3 smaller filer counts than Q2/Q4); share dynamics track despite level distortion in some quarters.

indicators.title: Broker Dealer Leverage (Dealer financing)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: 100 x (security broker/dealer repo assets + repo liabilities) / GDP, percent (quarter-end levels).

indicators.title: Short Term Wholesale Funding (Ratio of Gross Short-Term Wholesale Debt of the Financial Sector to GDP)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: 100 x (financial-sector short-term loans liabilities + open market paper liabilities) / GDP, percent (quarter-end levels).

indicators.title: Illiquidity Conventration Indicator
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: (Corporate and foreign bond assets + total loan assets) / total financial assets of domestic financial sectors, share (quarter-end levels).
indicators.note: Public proxy for the paper's illiquidity-concentration concept; the authors' published series is unfetchable.

indicators.title: Maturity Mismatch (Loans as a percent of deposits)
indicators.source: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC) / Chicago Fed, Y-9C bulk data
indicators.definition: 100 x (total loans and leases) / (total deposits, domestic + foreign offices), aggregated across all Y-9C filers, percent.

indicators.title: Weighted Average Maturity Gap at Commerical Banks
indicators.source: Fitted proxy from public macro inputs (no direct public measurement)
indicators.definition: OLS regression of the authors' accessible maturity-gap series (1997Q2-2010Q4) on the 10-year Treasury yield, VIX, and the loans-to-deposits ratio; fitted gap in months.
indicators.note: Fitted, not directly measured: gap = -1.87 - 3.40*y10 - 0.144*vix + 0.423*loan_dep (in-sample R2 0.80, RMSE 1.8 months); out-of-sample quarters rely on the 1997-2010 relationship holding. 2026Q1-Q2 values are regression-extensions (see nowcast provenance).

indicators.title: Broker Dealer Leverage (Broker dealer leverage ratio)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: 100 x (total financial assets - total liabilities) / total financial assets for security brokers and dealers, i.e. the equity/assets capital ratio, percent (quarter-end levels).
indicators.note: Built as equity/assets (not assets/equity) because the accessible series behaves as a capital ratio; pipeline sign is -1.

indicators.title: Maturity Mismatch (Ratio of net short-term wholesale debt of the financial sector to GDP)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: 100 x (short-term loans liabilities + open market paper liabilities - fed funds & repo assets - open market paper assets of domestic financial sectors) / GDP, percent (quarter-end levels).

indicators.title: Ratio of U.S. Non Agency Securitization Issuance to GDP
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: 100 x (ABS-issuer sector net transactions, $M SAAR / 1000) / GDP ($B SAAR), percent; public net-issuance measure of the non-agency securitization universe.
indicators.note: Net transactions, not SIFMA gross issuance (SIFMA public quarterly history is truncated).

indicators.title: Short-term Wholesale Funding (Ratio of total runnable money -like liabilities to GDP)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: (Fed funds & repo liabilities + open market paper liabilities + money market fund shares of domestic financial sectors) / GDP, ratio (quarter-end levels).
indicators.note: Omits uninsured deposits, variable-rate demand obligations, and securities lending (not in Z.1).

indicators.title: Short-Term Wholesale Funding (Short-term money as a share of assets at BHCs)
indicators.source: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC) / Chicago Fed, Y-9C bulk data
indicators.definition: 100 x (fed funds purchased + repos + other borrowed money with remaining maturity <= 1 year) / total assets, aggregated across all Y-9C filers, percent.
indicators.note: Fed funds + repos leg spliced: BHCK2800 (1990Q1-2001Q4) to BHCKB995+BHCKB996 (2002Q1+); level runs below the paper's broader 'short-term money' aggregate.

indicators.title: Bank Leverage (Total common equity to total assets)
indicators.source: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC) / Chicago Fed, Y-9C bulk data
indicators.definition: 100 x (total common equity - intangible assets) / (total assets - intangible assets), i.e. tangible common equity / tangible assets, aggregated across all Y-9C filers, percent.

indicators.title: Bank Leverage (Tier 1 common equity ratio)
indicators.source: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC) / Chicago Fed, Y-9C bulk data
indicators.definition: 100 x (Tier 1 capital - perpetual preferred - minority interest - qualifying trust preferred) / total risk-weighted assets, Y-9C aggregate, percent.
indicators.note: Series starts 2001Q1 (risk-weighted assets item BHCKB704 first appears then); spliced across the Basel III 2014 break to HC-R reporters (2014Q1+). Pre-2004 trust preferred treated as zero.

indicators.title: Bank Leverage (Total Capital Ratio)
indicators.source: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), Call Reports / Y-9C Schedule RC-R
indicators.definition: 100 x (Tier 1 + Tier 2 capital) / total risk-weighted assets, percent.
indicators.note: Series starts 2001Q1 (risk-weighted assets item first appears then); rebuilt from Y-9C/Call Report RC-R aggregates with a Basel III HC-R splice from 2014Q1. No single landing-page URL is documented in the pipeline code, so no link is claimed.

indicators.title: Ratio of Total Financial Sector Liabilities to GDP
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: (Domestic financial-sector total liabilities, $M / 1000) / GDP ($B SAAR), ratio (quarter-end levels).

indicators.title: Ratio of Nonfinancial Business Savings to GDP
indicators.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), NIPA quarterly bulk data
indicators.definition: 100 x (net lending (+) / net borrowing (-) of domestic business, i.e. saving net of capital formation) / GDP, percent.
indicators.note: Current-vintage NIPA Table 5.1 no longer splits financial vs nonfinancial business; domestic-business net lending is the closest public quarterly aggregate.

indicators.title: Comsumer Credit of Riskier Borrowers (Ratio of consumer credit debt owed by riskier borrowers to DPI)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: 100 x (quarterly average revolving consumer credit outstanding, $M) / (quarterly average nominal DPI, $B x 1000), percent of DPI.
indicators.note: Revolving (credit-card) balances are the segment where riskier borrowers concentrate; the stock/DPI ratio tracks the paper's CCP-microdata riskier-borrower debt stock.

indicators.title: Consumer Credit (Consumer credit ratio to GDP)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Total consumer credit outstanding ($B) / GDP ($B SAAR), ratio (quarter-end levels).

indicators.title: Consumer Credit (Consumer credit debt service ratio to DPI)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Total household debt service payments as a percent of disposable personal income (Fed DSR release), percent (quarter-end values).
indicators.note: TDSP covers all household debt including mortgages, while the paper uses a consumer-only DSR; series starts 2005Q1 (the current DSR release's history boundary).

indicators.title: Debt Burden of Nonfinancial Businesses (Debt-to-Income ratio)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: 100 x (nonfinancial corporate + noncorporate business debt securities and loans) / GDP, percent (quarter-end levels).

indicators.title: Real Debt Growth of Nonfinancial Businesses
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Year-on-year percent change of GDP-deflated total nonfinancial business debt.

indicators.title: Ratio of Household Savings to GDP
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: (Personal saving rate as a share of DPI) x (nominal DPI) / GDP, i.e. household saving as a share of GDP.

indicators.title: Debt Burden of Nonfinancial Business (Interest expenses)
indicators.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), NIPA quarterly bulk data
indicators.definition: 100 x (net interest and miscellaneous payments) / (undistributed after-tax profits + consumption of fixed capital) for nonfinancial corporate business, percent.

indicators.title: Risky Debt of Nonfinancial Businesses (Deep junk Issuance Share)
indicators.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, FEDS Notes excess bond premium file
indicators.definition: Negated quarterly mean of the monthly excess bond premium (EBP), in percent: strong sentiment (low/negative EBP) coincides with low-quality firms issuing.
indicators.note: Honest coincident proxy only (weak correlation): no public quarterly CCC-or-below share of high-yield issuance exists.

indicators.title: Home Mortage Debt (Ratio of mortgage debt owed by riskier borrowers to DPI)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: 100 x (household mortgage debt, $B) / (nominal DPI, $B SAAR), percent of DPI.
indicators.note: Aggregate mortgage-debt/DPI stock as the public stand-in for the paper's CCP-based riskier-borrower mortgage debt/DPI.

indicators.title: Home Mortage Debt (Ratio of total mortgage debt to GDP)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Household mortgage debt ($B) / GDP ($B SAAR), ratio (quarter-end levels).

indicators.title: Home Mortgage Debt (Total mortgage debt service ratio to DPI)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Mortgage debt service payments as a percent of disposable personal income (Fed DSR release), percent (quarter-end values).
indicators.note: Series starts 2005Q1 (the current DSR release's history boundary).

indicators.title: Risky Debt of Nonfinancial Businesses
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: 100 x (nonfinancial corporate business debt securities and loans) / (nonfinancial corporate business total assets), percent (quarter-end levels).
indicators.note: Aggregate net-leverage analogue of the paper's Compustat-based net leverage of speculative-grade/unrated firms.

indicators.title: Mortgage Borrowing by Riskier Borrowers (Incidence of piggy-back mortgages by riskier borrowers)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts via FRED
indicators.definition: 100 x (closed-end junior-lien home equity loans outstanding) / (household mortgage debt), percent (quarter-end levels).
indicators.note: Series starts 1990Q4 (Z.1 home-equity-loan history boundary; 1990Q1-Q3 are missing). A stock share, not purchase-money incidence.

indicators.title: Consumer Credit of Riskier Borrowers (Incidence of very rapid consumer borrowing by riskier borrowers)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Year-on-year percent change of quarterly revolving consumer credit outstanding, percent.
indicators.note: Rapid aggregate revolving-balance growth as the public stand-in for the paper's CCP-based incidence of very rapid borrowing.

indicators.title: Mortgage Borrowing by Riskier Borrowers (Incidence of very rapid mortgage borrowing by riskier borrowers)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Year-on-year percent change of quarterly household mortgage debt outstanding, percent.

indicators.title: Spread of Corporate Bonds (over Treasury Securities) (BBB)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Quarterly mean of monthly Moody's Baa yield minus quarterly mean of daily 10-year Treasury yield, percentage points.
indicators.note: Public analog of the paper's ICE BofA BBB option-adjusted spread.

indicators.title: Indicators of Volitility (Credit Default Swap premium)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED) + Board of Governors FEDS Notes EBP file
indicators.definition: Expected-default component of the Baa credit spread: (Moody's Baa - 10y Treasury) minus the Fed excess bond premium (Gilchrist-Zakrajsek decomposition), percentage points, quarterly means.
indicators.note: Public analog of proprietary Markit IG CDS premia; distinct from the full BBB spread by construction (correlation 0.58). EBP file: https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/notes/feds-notes/ebp_csv.csv (1973+).

indicators.title: Equity Valuations (Ratro minus 10 Yr. Tres. Yeild)
indicators.source: Shiller long-run stock market data + Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: Shiller earnings/price ratio minus the 10-year Treasury yield (quarterly mean of monthly E/P minus quarterly mean of daily DGS10), percentage points.

indicators.title: Equity Valuations (Earnings/Price ratio )
indicators.source: Shiller long-run stock market data
indicators.definition: Shiller earnings/price ratio, quarterly mean of monthly values, percent.

indicators.title: Mortage Lending and FICO Scores (FICO scores)
indicators.source: GSE credit supplements (Fannie Mae), transcribed annual file
indicators.definition: Annual UPB-weighted mean origination FICO for GSE single-family acquisitions, interpolated from annual (mid-year) points to quarterly by natural cubic spline.
indicators.note: Series starts 2003Q1: the acquisitions table begins with the 2003 acquisition year; earlier supplements profiled the outstanding book, not acquisitions by year. No public landing page is documented in the pipeline code, so no link is claimed.

indicators.title: National House Prices Relative to Rents
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: S&P/Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index divided by the CPI rent-of-primary-residence index, ratio of quarterly means.

indicators.title: Spread of Corporate Bonds (over Treasury Securities) (High Yield)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED) + Board of Governors FEDS Notes EBP file
indicators.definition: Monthly Moody's Baa-Treasury spread plus monthly excess bond premium, averaged to quarterly, percentage points (high-yield spread proxy).
indicators.note: EBP file: https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/notes/feds-notes/ebp_csv.csv. Replaces the earlier Baa-only proxy.

indicators.title: Investor Appetite for Risky Corporate Debt (Issuance of Junk Bonds and Leverage Loans)
indicators.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, FEDS Notes GZ credit-spread file
indicators.definition: Inverse of the quarterly mean monthly Gilchrist-Zakrajsek average credit spread (1 / GZ spread): tight spreads read as strong investor appetite for risky debt.
indicators.note: Public proxy: no public quarterly leveraged-loan issuance series exists and SIFMA public quarterly HY history is truncated; proprietary Dealogic/LCD issuance is the paper's concept.

indicators.title: Prices for Commercial Real Estate (CRE)
indicators.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), commercial property price statistics
indicators.definition: BIS U.S. quarterly commercial property price index, nominal, index level as published.
indicators.note: Manual download (BIS portal); the pipeline applies a 10-year moving-average detrend at index stage, so level/base differences wash out. Draft URL https://www.bis.org/statistics/pp/pp_detailed.htm returned HTTP 404; nulled.

indicators.title: Change in Lending Standards, CRE Loans
indicators.source: Federal Reserve, Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey (SLOOS) historical tables
indicators.definition: Net percent of domestic banks tightening standards for CRE loans, percent.
indicators.note: Splice: discontinued aggregate series 1990Q2-2013Q2 (re-dated back one quarter to the paper's reference-quarter convention) joined to the mean of the three successor sub-questions from 2013Q3. Draft URL https://www.federalreserve.gov/data/sloos/sloos_xml.htm returned HTTP 404; nulled. Series read from work/raw/sloos_cre.csv (pre-transcribed).

indicators.title: Mortage Lending and FICO Scores (Change in Lending Standards)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve, Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey (SLOOS) via FRED
indicators.definition: Net percent of banks tightening standards for prime residential mortgages (SLOOS), quarterly survey value.
indicators.note: Series starts 2007Q2: the April 2007 survey split the single all-residential question into prime/nontraditional/subprime and discontinued the aggregate; the prime-only concept did not exist before.

indicators.title: Investor Appetite for Risky Corporate Debt (Change in Bank Lending Standards C&I Loans)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve, Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey (SLOOS) via FRED
indicators.definition: Net percent of banks tightening standards for C&I loans to large and middle-market firms (SLOOS), quarterly survey value.

indicators.title: Indicators of Volitility (VIX)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
indicators.definition: CBOE Volatility Index (VIX), quarterly mean of daily closes; the pipeline applies a log transform at index stage.

indicators.title: SRISK (Total capital shortfall relative to total assets)
indicators.source: Built series (NYU Stern V-LAB method) from Y-9C book data, Yahoo Finance prices, SEC EDGAR XBRL
indicators.definition: Sum of positive firm-level SRISK over 20 large U.S. BHCs divided by their summed book assets; firm SRISK = max(0, 8% x book liabilities - 92% x market cap x (1 - LRMES)).
indicators.note: V-LAB's downloadable SRISK requires login, so the series is rebuilt from public inputs using V-LAB's documented method. Series truncated at 2000Q1 on input reliability; survivors-only panel (delisted crisis-era firms excluded), so the 2008 peak is understated vs V-LAB. No single landing-page URL is documented in the pipeline code, so no link is claimed.

indicators.title: Granger-causality connections among large financial institutions
indicators.source: Built series from Yahoo Finance monthly returns (Billio et al. 2012 method)
indicators.definition: Share of statistically significant (5%, HAC-robust) pairwise linear Granger-causality edges among monthly log returns of 30 large listed U.S. financial firms, 36-month rolling windows stepped quarterly.
indicators.note: Billio et al. use 100 firms with GARCH pre-filtering; hedge funds have no public return data and delisted firms no public price history, so this replication uses 30 listed firms without GARCH filtering. No single landing-page URL is documented in the pipeline code, so no link is claimed.

indicators.title: Hedge Fund Leverage (Gross assets to net assets, qualifying hedge funds)
indicators.source: Office of Financial Research (OFR) Hedge Fund Monitor, SEC Form PF aggregates
indicators.definition: Ratio of published Form PF aggregates: gross assets / net assets of qualifying hedge funds, equal to the net-asset-weighted mean fund-level leverage ratio.
indicators.note: Series begins 2013Q1 (Form PF quarterly reporting start); aggregate ratio, not a fund-level distribution; published with roughly a one-quarter lag.

indicators.title: Hedge Fund Leverage (SCOOS net percent reporting increased use of leverage)
indicators.source: Federal Reserve, Senior Credit Officer Opinion Survey (SCOOS) via FRED
indicators.definition: Net percent of dealers reporting increased use of leverage by hedge funds, quarterly survey value (quarter-start dates).
indicators.note: Series begins 2011Q3; a diffusion index of changes in leverage use, not a leverage level (bounded -100..100).
